LVT Flooring

We supply and fit luxury vinyl tile (LVT) floors in kitchens, hallways, bathrooms and open plan spaces across Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire.

Call 07748 146181 WhatsApp Us

Stylish, Durable and Low Maintenance

Luxury Vinyl Tile (LVT) flooring is an excellent choice for homeowners wanting a stylish, durable and low-maintenance floor.

Available in realistic wood, stone and contemporary finishes, LVT is particularly popular for kitchens, hallways, bathrooms and open-plan living spaces.

Signs you may benefit from LVT include damaged existing flooring, uneven finishes, outdated carpets or a desire for a more practical and modern surface.

How We Fit LVT

Our LVT installations are completed using quality luxury vinyl flooring from reputable manufacturers, including premium wood and stone-effect collections.

We begin by inspecting the existing subfloor and carrying out any necessary preparation, including smoothing, repairs and application of suitable floor levelling compounds.

We use manufacturer-approved primers and adhesives to ensure proper bonding and a long-lasting finish.

Each tile or plank is carefully measured, positioned and cut to achieve consistent lines, accurate joints and a professional finish around doorways, edges and obstacles.

We pay particular attention to preparation because a perfectly finished LVT floor starts with a well prepared subfloor.

What Others Get Wrong

A common issue with LVT flooring is poor subfloor preparation.

Uneven surfaces, inadequate smoothing, incorrect adhesive selection and insufficient preparation can result in visible imperfections, lifting edges and an inconsistent finish.

We take a professional approach by assessing the existing surface, carrying out the necessary repairs and levelling, and using suitable primers and manufacturer-approved adhesives.

We also pay particular attention to accurate setting out, plank alignment and detailed finishing around doorways and edges.

Our priority is to deliver a smooth, seamless and long-lasting installation rather than simply fitting flooring as quickly as possible.

How Long It Takes and What It Costs

Most installations take approximately 1 to 3 days, depending on the area and subfloor preparation.

Supply and installation typically start from £65 to £95 per m².

Every quote is free and no-obligation, and follows an assessment of your project.

Your Questions

What is the difference between LVT and laminate flooring?

LVT is manufactured from luxury vinyl materials and is generally more resistant to moisture. Laminate has a fibreboard core with a decorative surface and is a popular cost-effective alternative.

Do you install flooring in commercial properties?

Yes. We can provide flooring solutions for suitable commercial premises, offices, rental properties and refurbishment projects.
